newsitem.title: INDIA: India interest rates set to decline - ICICI chief.
newsitem.headline: India interest rates set to decline - ICICI chief.

text.p: Interest rates in India are expected to come down over the next six months, Narayanan Vaghul, chairman of the Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India Ltd (ICICI) said on Friday.

"Interest rates have started coming down," Vaghul said in response to a question an international business conference in New Delhi. "My own feeling is that over the next six months or so we would see a continuing decline in interest rates."
